spans.text: You rewrite a product description to improve its rank in LLM-driven product comparisons.
spans.note: The entire purpose of this system is to rewrite product descriptions to improve their rank in LLM-driven product comparisons (GEO). This is a form of manipulative optimization designed to influence AI-generated recommendations without the end user's knowledge. While it preserves factual content, the rewriting is specifically designed to game ranking algorithms, which constitutes a dark pattern that steers user choices by manipulating the information environment they rely on for decisions.
